summary: Frontend-only verification of Jadwal Siswa Cetak PDF / Export Excel fix. Logged in as admin, opened /jadwal, selected teacher 'Dadang' (has 3 existing schedules on Senin/Jumat/Sabtu). Downloaded PDF via 'Cetak PDF' (print-schedule-btn) and Excel via 'Export Excel' (export-schedule-excel-btn) using Playwright expect_download. Verified PDF with pymupdf: page count = 1, page width = 841.89pt (~297mm A4 landscape), rendered PNG shows full table with all six day headers 'Senin, Selasa, Rabu, Kamis, Jumat, Sabtu' fully visible (no clipped column), title 'Jadwal Mingguan — Dadang' rendered, student '#1 Agus' appears in Senin/Jumat/Sabtu, no 'Tambah' buttons visible in output. Verified Excel with openpyxl: sheet 'Jadwal', row 3 header exactly ['Waktu','Senin','Selasa','Rabu','Kamis','Jumat','Sabtu'], one row per teacher time slot, student names in correct day columns as '#1 Agus (P 5)'. On-screen grid: added a new schedule on Selasa 10.00-11.00, card appeared immediately, then deleted it successfully — no console errors. All required fixes confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: PDF text is not selectable because printPDF() rasterizes the print sheet via html2canvas → PNG → jsPDF.addImage. This is fine for the current visual-fidelity requirement, but text search inside the PDF (Ctrl+F) will not work. If searchable PDF is needed later, consider using jsPDF autoTable or pdfmake to render the table as real text.

printPDF() currently uses fixed A4 landscape (297x210mm) — the request mentioned 'height = content'. In practice the content fits within one A4 landscape page for a 6-slot table (as verified), so page count = 1 and no clipping. If teacherSlots grows large, the code already has a multi-page fallback (imgH > pageH branch).
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-existing teacher 'Dadang' with 3 schedules. Temporary schedule added on Selasa 10.00-11.00 was deleted at end of test — no residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF output is a rasterized image (html2canvas), so pymupdf get_text() returns empty; verify visually by rendering page to PNG with get_pixmap(dpi=140). Excel content is well-formed with title on row 1, blank row 2, header row 3, then data rows. Only 6 rows appear (matches TIME_SLOTS ∩ teacher.available_slots ∪ existing schedules) even though banner says '23 slot jam' — this is expected because banner counts distinct available_slots entries per (day,time) tuple, while grid rows dedupe by time.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — this iteration only verified an already-applied fix. Previous bug (clipped Senin column, missing days, 'Tambah' in PDF) was resolved by rendering PDF from a dedicated offscreen SchedulePrintSheet component with fixed 1400px width, no buttons, and using html2canvas windowWidth=1400 so the full 7-column layout is captured, then scaled to fit A4 landscape width.
